metadata.title: SIH 2026 Representative Queries — SatQuery-AI Acceptance Tests
metadata.problem_statement: SIH26167: Interactive Vision-Language Assistant for Multimodal Remote Sensing Image Analysis through Text Queries
metadata.note: This harness tests functional pipeline behavior only. It does NOT claim satisfaction of remote-sensing model adaptation/fine-tuning (e.g. BigEarthNet) requirements.

fixtures.sar_note: No SAR fixture exists in tests/data/. Test 04 (Optical+SAR) is BLOCKED until a real SAR image is added.

tests.name: Land-Cover VQA
tests.query: Describe the land-cover and major objects visible in this image.

provider.fallback_condition: Eligible Gemini provider/runtime failure (HTTP 429, timeout, missing API key)

tests.name: Water Body Grounding
tests.query: Highlight the water body referred to in the query.

provider.fallback_condition: Qwen is NEVER used for Grounding

tests.name: Bi-temporal Change Detection
tests.query: What changed between these two dates, and where did the change occur?

provider.fallback_condition: Qwen is NEVER used for Change Detection

tests.name: Optical + SAR Cross-Modal Analysis
tests.query: Use the optical and SAR images together to identify built-up and water-covered regions.
tests.blocked_reason: MISSING_SAR_FIXTURE: No real SAR image exists in tests/data/. Cannot relabel an optical image as SAR.

tests.name: Built-up Area Change Analysis
tests.query: Has the built-up area increased, decreased, or remained unchanged?

provider.fallback_condition: Qwen is NEVER used for Change Detection

tests.note: The current Change Detection tool reports pixel-level change metrics (change_percentage, changed_pixels). It does NOT compute built-up-area hectares, coordinates, or land-class percentages. The test validates that the tool produces an honest answer using its actual capabilities without fabricating unsupported measurements.
